section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study examining the psychometric properties of a Romanian translation of the BAS-2 in a sample of Romanian adults. The study aims to examine the factor structure, internal consistency, sex invariance, test-retest reliability, and convergent validity of the BAS-2, with expected negative associations between BAS-2 scores and BMI.
